description: Use this to learn one character before casting it or using it elsewhere: its look word for word, personality, speaking style, backstory, directing notes, signature details and consistency rules, every picture with a download link (full size for the BudgetPixel influencers and the user's own characters, so they can be used with other tools too), the models a mention works on, and the terms for using an influencer. Use the profile to write prompts, captions and scripts in the character's own voice. Free.

handle.description: The character's handle, with or without the @ (e.g. "barry"), from list_characters.
